home.text: Personalized private, one-on-one care in Cave Creek with solutions for thinning hair, added density, extensions, color, and complete hair transformations.

Every service begins with your hair and your history — never with a catalogue. We look at where your hair is now, what you want to achieve, and what will work best before creating a plan specifically for you. Whether that means restoring lost density, adding length and fullness, or creating something entirely new, Niki builds the solution around you. No crowded salon. Just experienced, one-on-one care designed for your hair.
Every service begins with understanding your hair, your history, and what’s possible — then creating a solution that’s entirely your own.

I started seeing Niki about 3 years ago. My hair had stopped growing; my color was awful, everything was thinning! We started out with extensions and color. It made my hair/head look amazing. We also started using a good shampoo and conditioner and got rid of the junk I was using. Now, 3 years later, my color is beautiful, my extensions are amazing, AND......my hair is growing again... She's an expert in her craft. She'll take her time with you, listen to your concerns, and go over all options.
Niki is not only sweet, she is super knowledgeable about hair extensions! Best experience I’ve ever had! Hands down best hair artist! 5 stars!

Nikki has been an absolute godsend. I had no idea what to expect trying to regrow my hair after chemo, and she has walked my clueless-to-anything-related-to-hair/makeup/etc self through each step of the process, and has helped me have fun trying new styles/colors along the way. I drive from North Phoenix to be able to work with her, and it's worth every minute of it!

Niki is simply amazing with hair colors! She’s extremely talented! If you’re looking for someone to take your hair to that mermaid, unicorn or fantasy hair she’s definitely the best! Took my hair from boring brown to shades of purple, blues, and greenish teals

about.text: Nearly four decades behind the chair—and a career built on knowing there’s never just one way to care for someone’s hair.

Experience changes the way you see hair. Niki Z. has been a hair artisan since 1988, building a career that has taken her from the West Coast to New York City, Europe, and the Middle East. Her experience spans hair color, extensions, styling, and makeup, but her work has never stopped behind the chair. Niki has trained salon professionals, presented on stages and in salons across the country, and served as an educator and platform artist for leading beauty brands including DevaCurl, Goldwell, Schwarzkopf International, Chromastics, and Microchet. Today, that depth of experience shapes every client experience at Xtend Yourself. Niki believes you deserve to understand your hair, your options, and what will actually work for you. Her approach is straightforward and refreshingly honest—tell it like it is, educate first, and create a solution around the person sitting in her chair. Because the goal has never been to simply give you great hair. It’s helping you find the look that feels completely like you.
I'm proud to be certified in multiple industry-leading extention methods, allowing me to customize the best solution for your hair goals, lifestyle and individual needs
